build.buildCommand: pnpm --filter @land-intelligence/database run db:generate && pnpm build && mkdir -p apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/.next/ && mkdir -p apps/web/.next/standalone/.next && cp -r apps/web/.next/static apps/web/.next/standalone/.next/

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma db push --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 PORT=$PORT node apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web/server.js
